name: SOHEIL-DS
notes:
AS402366 is a Canadian network operator and managed infrastructure provider. We operate provider-independent IPv4 and IPv6 resources and support BGP routing, customer prefix announcements, and transit services.

Current network presence includes Western Canada, and the United States. We maintain redundant upstream connectivity and actively participate in the Internet routing community.

Peering requests are welcome and will be evaluated based on traffic patterns, routing policy, and mutual benefit.
